title: Anthropic 投资需求火热，承销商拟将 IPO 目标估值上调回 $1.5T 或更高
content:
Rohan Paul· @rohanpaul_ai · X·· 55 分钟前精选AI 评分85
AI 导读
FT 报道，因投资者需求旺盛，Anthropic 承销商计划上调 IPO 定价，把目标估值拉回 $1.5T 或更高。周二文件设定 $70-$78 的发行区间，计入员工期权和受限股后对应 $1.26T-$1.41T 估值；若定价超出区间，募资将超过 $100B，其中 Google、Nvidia 和 Microsoft 将按 IPO 价格投资 $26B。
推荐理由
报道补充了定价区间、募资用途和三大科技公司的入股安排，可帮助读者理解这桩 IPO 的资金结构与定价逻辑。
正文 · AI 翻译
FT：Anthropic 的银行家计划在投资者需求旺盛后上调其 IPO 价格，将目标估值重新提升至 1.5 万亿美元或更高。
周二的申报文件设定了每股 70 至 78 美元的价格区间，计入员工期权和限制性股票后，隐含估值为 1.26 万亿至 1.41 万亿美元。
若定价高于该区间，募资额将超过 1000 亿美元，其中包括 Google、Nvidia 和 Microsoft 将按 IPO 价格投资的 260 亿美元。
三位支持者表示，Anthropic 现在更看重筹集现金，而非最大化估值，因为它计划投入约 9000 亿美元用于算力和基础设施支出。
来源：Rohan Paul · x.com

report.summary: Strong investor demand reportedly pushes Anthropic's underwriters to raise its IPO valuation target back to $1.5T or more, with Google, Nvidia and Microsoft anchoring $26B at the offer price.
report.background: Anthropic has spent the past two years turning Claude from a research project into one of the most widely deployed frontier-model families, funded by strategic capital from Google, Amazon and — per this report — Nvidia and Microsoft. Its cost base is dominated by compute rather than headcount: training runs, inference capacity and multi-year datacenter commitments now absorb capital at a pace private rounds struggle to match. That is why frontier labs are drifting toward public markets. Context matters here, because the reported figures would shatter every precedent — Saudi Aramco's 2019 listing, the largest IPO ever, raised roughly $29B at a ~$1.7T valuation. A $100B+ raise at a $1.5T valuation would be an order of magnitude beyond anything the tech sector has attempted, and would effectively ask public investors to underwrite frontier-AI capex at sovereign-fund scale.
key_points: Pricing mechanics: Tuesday's filing set a $70–$78 per-share range which, once employee options and restricted stock are counted, implies a $1.26T–$1.41T valuation. Underwriters now believe demand supports pricing above that range, which would pull the headline valuation back to $1.5T or higher.

Raise size: pricing above the range would push gross proceeds past $100B, making this — if it happens — by far the largest equity offering in corporate history and a genuine stress test of public-market appetite for AI exposure.

Anchor checks: Google, Nvidia and Microsoft would invest $26B at the IPO price, meaning the same firms that supply Anthropic's chips, cloud capacity and distribution would also become public-equity holders — a striking concentration of supplier and shareholder interests.

Cash over valuation: the report says Anthropic is prioritising how much money it raises over maximising the headline number, because it plans roughly $900B of compute and infrastructure spending. That framing explains the willingness to expand the book rather than hold the price.

Reality check: none of these figures are confirmed by filings reviewed here, and the magnitudes ($100B raised, $900B capex, $1.5T valuation) exceed anything in tech history. Treat the numbers as reported expectations from unnamed backers, not as settled terms.
report.impact: For the AI industry, a listing at this scale would convert public equity into the newest funding source for frontier compute, pressuring OpenAI and other private labs to follow or justify their private marks. It also formalises a circular structure — chip vendors and cloud providers holding equity in their largest customer — that regulators are already circling. For developers, a well-capitalised Anthropic means more predictable long-term API availability and enterprise SLAs, but public-market pressure for margins could push pricing toward usage-based enterprise contracts and away from generous free tiers. For regular users, expect deeper bundling of Claude into Google Cloud, Azure and Nvidia-adjacent platforms, which raises convenience while deepening dependence on a handful of firms.
report.tools: To follow the story, watch Anthropic's SEC filings (S-1 and amendments) for real numbers rather than leaks, and the Claude API, Claude Code and MCP (Model Context Protocol) for product direction. Amazon Bedrock and Google Vertex AI show how Claude reaches enterprises. For hands-on comparison, run open-weight alternatives — Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek — locally via vLLM or Ollama to gauge how far open models trail Claude on your own workloads.
